svg.title: Динамический жим Паллофа в шаге — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Dynamic Pallof press with one lateral step OUT, anti-rotation. Full-body front-three-quarter view and one tall anchor post to the left side of athlete with one flat resistance band anchored at sternum height. Same post and side on both frames. LEFT initial stance narrow and both hands hold band at chest, elbows bent. RIGHT visibly steps right foot sideways AWAY from anchor to wider stance, with left foot still in original position, both hands extend together in front of sternum at shoulder height. Hips and shoulders face forward unchanged, never turning toward anchor. Both ends of one stretched band visible from fixed anchor to hands. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
